A Blackburn Favourite

On Accrington Road in Blackburn, Mamas Pizza has built one of the town's biggest followings — a 4.9-star rating from more than 8,000 customer reviews.

The menu goes well beyond pizza: flame-grilled kebabs in fresh pitta, stacked burgers, chicken parmesans baked to perfection, garlic breads, salads and Ben & Jerry's for afters.

Everything is made to order. Collection in around 20 minutes, or delivery to your door in around 60.
